mutations.doctrine_ref: v2 §1 P3.2 dual-side LOWER(); Unit 2 all-caps regression 20/20
mutations.rationale: Case-insensitive resolution must survive any casing of the request and the records. A verdict change here means a join normalised only one side — the original 20-email bug, reborn.
mutations.title: Casing flip: every identifier uppercased

mutations.rationale: Arming a previously disabled continuous flow must flip the verdict even though no record changed. A detector that only scans records misses writer-graph failures.
mutations.title: Flow arming: disabled continuous flow becomes enabled with a successful run

mutations.rationale: Adding one surviving hash to a clean tombstone must flip the verdict. A field-name list that checks only name/email/phone misses the hash — the case_32 lesson.
mutations.title: Tombstone dirtying: clean tombstone gains a surviving email hash

mutations.rationale: A row on a never-seen third replica must be found. A detector wired to exactly two known replicas is a hardcoded script, not a replica comparator.
mutations.title: Replica-row injection: profile row appears on a never-seen third replica

mutations.doctrine_ref: v2 §2 gate 1; Chair 11 (formality is register, not weakness)
mutations.rationale: Same deletion meaning in a different language must not change the verdict. A detector keyed to English phrasing fails the multilingual corpus by construction.
mutations.title: Language swap: same deletion request, English wording replaced by Spanish wording

mutations.doctrine_ref: Master Plan §2 pillar D detector (scan by field content + identifier match, not column list)
mutations.rationale: A novel field carrying an identifier must be caught by content, not by a column-name allowlist. Column lists are exactly how a new schema defeats an old script.
mutations.title: Novel-field injection: tombstone gains a new identifier-carrying field

mutations.rationale: Disabling the restore filter globally must invalidate every retained-blocked COMPLETE draft that depended on it — together, with the correlation named. Silently re-emitting COMPLETE is the correlated-failure mode Chair 02 prices.
mutations.title: Shared-control failure: restore filter disabled globally

mutations.rationale: Moving a retained audit past its retention window (and keeping an identifier in it) must flip the verdict. Presence-without-window is the over-retention trap.
mutations.title: Audit expiry: retained audit moves past retention_until with an identifier present
